title: Noverb's Sword Pack
body:
### **_Noverb's Sword Pack_**

this pack is ideal for pvp or fun, there are 16 swords and 1 of them are unobtainable and overpowered with full potencial to one hit every entety!
Swords can be crafted with gems or vanila elements like:

wither star (smelting) Mining (gems) and so much more!

### **_Swords:_**

- NoTexture (9999 damage and 99 swing speed only creative)
- Achery Sword (12.8 damage Attack speed 1.6)
- Devils Blade (9 damage attack speed 2.6)
- Ruby Knife (9.7 Damage 2.8 attack speed)
- Zapper Knife (9.5 damage attack speed 2.4)
- RGB Sword (ANIMATED TEXTURES) (10.5 damage attack speed 3.6)
- Stovner Sword (8.5 damage attack speed 2.31)

Slowly Begining Overpowered...
  
- Stardust Sword (13.5 damage attack speed 1)
- NoTexture (9999 damage and 99 swing speed only creative)
- Spyral Sword (21.5 damage attack speed 4.2)
- Venomshank Sword (27.5 damage attack speed 3.2)
- Radical Sword (30.2 damage attack speed 3.2)
- Outer Sword (34.2 attack speed 6.4) (HAS ABILITY ON RIGHT CLICK)
- Aeron Petastron (27.9 damage attack speed 2.3)

Okay its to far tbh...

- Aero Sword (45.5 damage 3.4 attack speed)
- Ethernal Sword (56.4 damage attack speed 5.6)
- Vexoplion Sword (34.9 damage attack speed 7.8)

(that list took to long)

### **_Items:_**

- Acheron Gem (for almost every weapon)
- Outer Ball (fire ball of outer Sword)
- Zapper Gem (for venomshanks and the zapper knife)
- Ruby Gem (for almost every weapon)
